title: BuildMaster - AION 2 EU/Global Arcana und Soul Binding Datenbasis

regular_skill_rules.arcana_card_pool_rule: active: Chalice + exactly one of Parchment/Compass; passive: Chalice + exactly one of Bell/Mirror

probability_semantics.gear_probability: baseline unconditional per random option line prior to duplicate exclusion
probability_semantics.unique_card_four_distinct_skills: 4/pool_size; assumes no duplicate skill options within card
probability_semantics.after_current_options_exclusion: not calculated; use ingame actual odds
probability_semantics.aion2gg_chance_to_appear: chance to appear somewhere among all gear lines, NOT equal to one line chance
probability_semantics.item_tier_matters: CSV numeric ranges are reference tiers only

data_files.03: 255 per-slot general stats with numeric ranges and reference item levels
data_files.06: 40 arcana card item types (5 slots x 2 variants x 4 rarities)

limitations: German localizations from earlier BuildMaster, verify in the actual game client; leave missing names missing.
EU/Global client reference sources, no per item ID verification.
Not a damage, DPS or combat power formula database.
No guaranteed total chance of full item roll; rerolls differ based on exclusions.
